about.title: About utils
about.p1: utils is a collection of self-hosted web utilities built and maintained by <owner>Zihao Liu</owner>. It exists for three reasons: everyday tools for personal use, simple apps for family, and an open-source starting point for anyone who wants to self-host their own toolbox.
about.p2: The next big milestone is the agent chat: a browser UI for talking to AI coding agents (like Claude Code) running on our own server, inside Docker — your conversations never depend on a third-party hosted frontend.

chat.title: Ask the book
chat.passcodePrompt: Enter the family passcode to use the AI assistant
chat.greeting: Ask anything about the book — it looks up the relevant entries first and cites the section and item.
chat.placeholder: e.g. Should I co-sign a loan for a friend?
chat.busy: The assistant is answering someone else — try again in a moment.
chat.error: The assistant failed to answer. Please try again.
chat.disclaimer: Answers are based on the book and cite section/item numbers — not medical or legal advice.
